answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 4032 Country: India Title: Is the shiya allowed to perfom the hajj? Question: Is the shiya allowed to perfom the hajj? Answer ID: 4032 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 462/419=L) Shias are of different sects and all are not same, but legally everyone is allowed to perform hajj. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
